Muc duoi EBITDA: depreciation = khau hao & phan bo (khuon, thiet bi, phan mem mua dut); interest = lai vay & chi phi tai chinh (am neu lai tien gui > lai vay); income_tax = thue TNDN theo thang (bo trong/null de bang uoc tinh theo tax_rate x loi nhuan truoc thue duong; 0 = khong co thue). Thang chua co dong rieng se lay theo thang gan nhat da nhap. Them thang moi = them mot dong "YYYY-MM": {...}.
